164: func (f *Factory) WithProviderFactory(clusterConfigFile string, clusterConfig *v1alpha1.Cluster) *Factory {
165: 	switch clusterConfig.Spec.DatacenterRef.Kind {
166: 	case v1alpha1.VSphereDatacenterKind:
167: 		f.WithKubectl().WithGovc().WithWriter().WithCAPIClusterResourceSetManager()
168: 	case v1alpha1.DockerDatacenterKind:
169: 		f.WithDocker().WithKubectl()
170: 	case v1alpha1.TinkerbellDatacenterKind:
171: 		f.WithKubectl().WithTinkerbellClients(clusterConfigFile)
172: 	}
173: 
174: 	f.buildSteps = append(f.buildSteps, func(ctx context.Context) error {
175: 		if f.providerFactory != nil {
176: 			return nil
177: 		}
178: 
179: 		f.providerFactory = &factory.ProviderFactory{
180: 			DockerClient:              f.dependencies.DockerClient,
181: 			DockerKubectlClient:       f.dependencies.Kubectl,
182: 			VSphereGovcClient:         f.dependencies.Govc,
183: 			VSphereKubectlClient:      f.dependencies.Kubectl,
184: 			TinkerbellKubectlClient:   f.dependencies.Kubectl,
185: 			TinkerbellClients:         f.dependencies.TinkerbellClients,
186: 			Writer:                    f.dependencies.Writer,
187: 			ClusterResourceSetManager: f.dependencies.ResourceSetManager,
188: 		}
189: 
190: 		return nil
191: 	})
192: 
193: 	return f
194: }
